parts.desc: 说明何时发生、是普通信息、警告还是错误
parts.desc_en: Indicates when it occurred, whether it was a general message, warning, or error

parts.desc: 把同一次请求产生的多行日志串在一起，方便跨步骤追踪
parts.desc_en: String together multiple lines of logs generated by the same request to facilitate cross-step tracking

parts.desc: 记录动作、结果、耗时和必要标识，但不写密码、Token 或完整个人资料
parts.desc_en: Record actions, results, time taken and necessary identification, but do not write passwords, tokens or complete personal information

variants.when: 记录正常的关键业务动作
请求失败，需要定位和告警
variants.when_en: A failed request requiring diagnosis or alerting.

use.t: 记录时间、级别、请求 id、动作、结果和耗时
错误日志保留堆栈和必要上下文，用户响应保持简洁
部署后先复现一次，再按时间或 request id 搜索日志
对错误率、延迟和关键失败设置监控与告警

dont.t: 打印密码、Token、Cookie 或整份用户资料
只写“出错了”：没有动作、对象和错误原因
用日志代替错误处理：打印后仍假装请求成功
线上开启海量调试日志又从不清理，成本和噪音一起涨

lessonPractice.title: 线上订单接口偶发 500，现有日志只有“出错了”，客服给出发生时间和订单号。下一步怎样改进排查？

options.label: 记录时间、请求 ID、动作、耗时和错误堆栈，并按线索搜索复现
options.feedback: 可搜索上下文能串起一次请求的关键步骤，错误堆栈则帮助定位真正失败位置。

options.label: 把密码、Token、Cookie 和完整订单都打印出来方便比对
options.feedback: 敏感信息会进入长期日志和更多访问范围，排错不能以泄露用户凭证为代价。

options.label: 继续只写“出错了”，但把同一句日志提高到 error 级别
options.feedback: 提高级别不会增加动作、对象或原因，仍无法与客服提供的事件对应。

en.title: A production order API intermittently returns 500, and logs only say Error. Support provides time and order number. How should investigation improve?

options.label: Record time, request ID, action, duration, and stack, then search and reproduce from those clues
options.feedback: Searchable context connects the steps of one request, and the stack helps locate the actual failure.

options.label: Print passwords, tokens, cookies, and the complete order to make comparison easier
options.feedback: Sensitive data would enter durable logs and broader access, making diagnosis itself a credential leak.

options.label: Keep only Error but raise the same message to error severity
options.feedback: A higher level adds no action, object, or cause and still cannot connect to the reported incident.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为订单接口补充结构化服务端日志：时间、级别、request ID、订单引用、动作、耗时和错误堆栈。密码、Token、Cookie 和完整个人资料必须脱敏；复现后用 request ID 串起整条请求。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add structured server logs for the order API with time, level, request ID, safe order reference, action, duration, and stack. Redact passwords, tokens, cookies, and full personal data, then trace a reproduced request by ID.
